line: Crowley's Three of Wands is the card for the second decan of Aries, with the Sun as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aries.

quotes.quote: The Three of Wands is accordingly the Lord of Virtue.
It refers to the Sun in Aries, the Sign in which he is exalted.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Binah in the suit of Fire, and so represents the establishment of primeval Energy.
